name: remote-notification-does-not-start-a-turn
description: A Notification arrives from a remote session that has no turn in flight. It is logged, but the status stays idle: a notification refreshes a turn that exists and never creates one.
reason: Claude sends notifications outside turns too (for example an idle-input reminder). Treating one as a turn start would light the working status with nothing to ever clear it but the expiry.
source: DESIGN.md v1.10 'a notification refreshes an existing entry's timestamp (a turn waiting on the user is alive) but never creates one'; AppState.handleRemoteEvent(.notification)

hookEvent.text: Claude is waiting for your input

script.reason: No turn is in flight for this session.
A notification without a message gets the generic line.

transcript.text: Claude is waiting for your input
